name: conductor
description: GitHub issue skills for ordinary work, synchronous direction, and explicitly requested automation.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, review, and manage issues in your chosen mode
interface.longDescription: Use manage-issues, ask-user, plan, implement, and review during ordinary chat work. Director operation requires an explicit request and defaults to synchronous work by the current agent and subagents, without worktrees or a background runner. Explicit automated mode coordinates isolated workers, configured checks, independent review, original-thread repairs, and verified delivery. Human questions stay in chat unless an inbox is requested. Setup never starts production work.
